description: Test suite for command poll backoff logic, including functions that calculate backoff times, track command polls, reset counts, and prune stale polls.

methods.name: calculateBackoffMs
methods.description: Calculates backoff time in milliseconds based on poll count index.

methods.name: getCommandPollSuggestion
methods.description: Provides current backoff suggestion for a tracked command.

methods.name: pruneStaleCommandPolls
methods.description: Removes stale command poll entries exceeding maximum age.

methods.name: recordCommandPoll
methods.description: Records a command poll and adjusts backoff timing based on output.

methods.name: resetCommandPollCount
methods.description: Resets the poll count for a specific command.
